reason: I'd probably take the free audit because 45 minutes is cheap if it turns up real money. But once I've fixed the gaps and moved clients onto the new template, I can't see what I'm paying £500 a month for, so I wouldn't commit to a subscription off the back of it.
objection: It finds the money once and then what? After the first clean-up the monthly check will mostly tell me what my service desk lead should already be catching, and at our size we're on Pro, not Growth.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from the audit that leakage keeps coming back every month, e.g. it finds new unbilled time and licence drift on clients we'd already sorted, plus it running off the PSA with no setup work from my team.
